about: An open source ERP and CRM for running a business: contacts, invoices, orders, stock and accounting.

prs.title: Month-end invoices name the right previous and next month
prs.broken: Invoices dated the 29th to 31st named the wrong month in their notes. An invoice on 31 March said the previous month was March, not February.
prs.changed: Adding or removing a month now stops at the end of the shorter month instead of spilling into the next one.
prs.matters: Recurring invoices made at month end show the right billing month on the PDF.
